name: Hangzhou Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Cable Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the global market, focusing on the research, development, production, and distribution of a comprehensive range of wires and cables. Its extensive product catalog includes various cable types such as high-voltage, power, overhead, control, mineral insulation, mining, and rubber cables, as well as different kinds of wires, specifically aluminum alloy, overhead, and plastic wires. The company further provides specialized offerings for transmission initiatives, including high-voltage temperature-sensing cables, steel-core aluminum alloy wires, and heat-tolerant aluminum alloy wires. Established in 1958, the firm's main offices are situated in Hangzhou, China.
